newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAB weighs share issue to expand overseas.
newsitem.headline: SAB weighs share issue to expand overseas.

text.p: South African Breweries Ltd (SAB) said on Thursday it was considering a major share issue to fund its international expansion.

SAB said it would be holding private investor presentations between September 24 and October 3 in international financial centres to explore the possibility of issuing for cash ordinary shares up to five percent of the existing issued ordinary and automatically convertible preference shares.
Joint lead managers for the international investment project are Fleming Martin SA Ltd and Cazenove & Co. Sponsoring broker is Fergusson Bros Ltd.
